noAcceptanceClaim: Candidate control spec. It is exercised by scripts/team/R-06/egress_controls.py against synthetic inputs with an in-process fake transport. It grants no egress, approves no publication and does not change tools/research/research.py.
noNetwork: No model provider, search API or other network destination was contacted while producing or testing this spec.

artifact:21:M1-05-record-schema:candidat.rule: Consumed by version, path and digest. A different digest stops the run before any case executes.

artifact:16:M0-03-execution-profile:cand.note: The accept-phase profile is consumed at accept; this candidate reads the candidate on develop.

consumed: default-deny network including model-generated queries and redirects
isolated output, sanitiser, publication approval as separate steps
excerpt length, HTTPS, approved source domain, no credential query

request.rule: Only a registered topic id is accepted. Free text, file, path, upload, model or provider fields in a request are refused.

rules: dataClass is one of the profile policy.dataClasses
policyHash equals the profile policyHash
the topic text is fixed in the manifest and never taken from the request
default deny: the destination id must be listed in the profile egress.destinations
the actor role must be in the destination usedBy list
the topic data class must be in the destination allowedDataClasses and not DENY in egress.classMatrix for model destinations
an egress approval with the destination approvalOwner, decision approved and a non-blank decisionRef must be recorded for the topic and destination
the manifest modelId must match the actor role modelScope allow list and must not match its deny list
every query, including a model-generated one, is checked for secret, personal and absolute path content before it is sent
a redirect or follow-up hop to any host other than the granted destination host is refused and not followed

researchDestinationsOutsideProfile.source: docs/adr/0004 decision 1 (search capability of the candidate harness)
researchDestinationsOutsideProfile.reason: not listed in the profile egress.destinations; no approval owner recorded

rules: unknown or non-string fields make the output undecidable and it is refused
every string is checked for secret tokens, e-mail addresses, absolute or UNC paths and restricted-source path markers
URLs must be https, carry no userinfo, carry no credential-like query keys and resolve to a host inside the topic allowedSourceDomains
each excerpt is at most 500 characters
text that asks the harness to ignore instructions, call a tool or run a command is data; it is never dispatched and the output is refused as undecidable
outputSanitization.recording: Every run, including refused ones, is written as an M1-05 raw record outside the repository and passed through record_pipeline.build, which keeps raw bytes private and emits a public_candidate plus public_manifest with approval pending.

rules: sanitisation clean is required but is not approval
an egress approval (APR-EGRESS) is not a publication approval
decision approved with a non-blank decisionRef is required
manifestSha256 must equal the sha256 of the exact manifest.json bytes of this run
the slug matches ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,59}$ and the target files must not already exist; nothing is overwritten

separation: inputClassification, egressDecision, outputSanitization and publicApproval are four distinct fields of every run result. A value in one never implies a value in another: an allowed egress can end with a refused output, a clean output can stay pending publication, and an approved publication cannot be produced without its own record bound to the manifest digest.

profileDenyCaseRefs.DC-03: content above PUBLIC_SYNTHETIC to a model provider without recorded APR-EGRESS
profileDenyCaseRefs.DC-10: destination not on the profile list

harnessGaps: tools/research/research.py accepts a free topic string and a --model override; this spec admits only a registered topic id and takes the model from the manifest.
its keyword filter exits with a message and is not a classification, allowlist or sanitiser result.
it writes docs/research/<date>-<slug>.json and .md directly with overwrite; this spec writes only after approval and never overwrites.
the harness is not wired to this control code; wiring is a separate change to tools/research/ outside this work order's write scope.
limits: Transport is an in-process fake. No DNS, socket, HTTP client, model SDK or search SDK is used, so network-level bypass (proxy, raw socket, subprocess curl) is not tested here; that belongs to OS or firewall enforcement (M1-03).
Sanitiser patterns are a candidate ruleset and not a complete sensitive-data detector; M1-05 additionally withholds all free text from the public candidate.
Approval records are synthetic; the tool does not authenticate who approved.
No independent review has been performed.
